items.prompt: Redraw 双相星盘 game equipment card, square illustration. Reference is old card only for theme. Original new composition: ONE ancient astrolabe floating at a dramatic three-quarter tilt, large unified circular silhouette. Its two interlocking semicircular plates express alternating phases: warm desaturated brass martial half with one simple blade-shaped pointer; cool indigo silver magic half with a single luminous four-point star. One clean central axle connects both halves, a broad arc of pale energy suggests rotation from one phase into the other. Object fills frame, lower ring cropped slightly by lower edge. No person, no hands, no duplicated separate astrolabes, no chains, no readable inscriptions. Background quiet charcoal navy with two broad opposing color masses. 手绘二次元块面厚涂，哑光不透明覆色，大组综合色与连贯主暗面，少数宽弧笔和钝端短条塑形，笔形有方向。大片安静底色与选择性重点，金属只有局部窄亮边，不逐件刻满细密花纹或齿轮；轮廓清晰，内部细线弱于主形。不画全屏碎三角面、颗粒滤镜、反复碎高光或塑料精修。灰底，暖金与蓝紫少量鲜色点睛。No text, UI, frame or watermark.
